extraction.notes: Attachment 2 (seq 9, p.3), current quarter column only. The printed FFO subtotal is basic ($208,526); the diluted FFO ($209,709) adds back Series E preferred distributions ($1,183). Because the FFO-as-Adjusted and per-share figures are diluted, ffo_total is set to the diluted subtotal and the preferred add-back is carried as an 'other' adjustment in ffo_adjustments. Basic FFO of 208,526 is reproduced by the adjustments before that line. Checks: 208,526 + 1,183 = 209,709; 209,709 + 2,635 = 212,344; 212,344 - 12,299 = 200,045. Per-share checks: 209,709/353,653 = 0.59; 212,344/353,653 = 0.60; 200,045/353,653 = 0.57. DCP line is printed as '$-' and recorded as 0. Recurring capex is deducted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
